text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Truly the singing voice of an angel...!
Tonight was another magnificent session!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your sustained notes lasted longer than before.
Is that the fruit of your live concert practice?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I think that's part of it, too, but most likely...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list: I was thinking of using it for underwater training

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list: I heard your parents are jewelers, so I brought these instead of Go stones

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that sounds delightful.
I'll be in your care...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Training is fun in its own right, of course,
but more than anything, it makes me truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "It's the kindness of Trainer, thinking of me and devising ways to help."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "And so you're all fired up for training! Splendid! Canzone d'amore!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I hear a new melodia...!
Mr. Pisa, would you grace us with one more piece?
